ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. Recommendation is to investigate the cause of the failure and optimize the page for better performance.
insights: The homepage has the longest duration (1515 ms) but the lowest load time (410.4 ms), indicating that there may be unnecessary resources that can be removed or optimized.
The pricing page has the shortest duration (1008 ms) and load time (240.3 ms), suggesting that it is the most optimized page.
The blog page has the highest TTFB (305.3 ms) and FCP (449.7 ms), indicating that there is room for improvement in server-side rendering and above-the-fold content optimization.
